0022600172.text: The Miami Heat (2-4, 10th in the East and 1 game back in the Southeast) are visiting the 5-2 Los Angeles Lakers, who lead the Pacific, with Miami on a two-game winning streak after a 2-4 stretch. The Lakers are on a one-game winning streak and have gone 3-1 at home, while Adou Thiero is out with knee inflammation. The teams have not met yet in 2026-27, and the Heat lost both meetings in 2025-26, most recently 134-126 in Miami on March 19, 2026.
